headlines.text: On this day in 2023, the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Christian Cage vs. Darby Allin went to war in a 2 out of 3 Falls match, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 8.92 ? an outstanding performance from both sides. secondaries.text: Flash back to 2023, when Kris Statlander vs. Julia Hart fought tooth and nail for the AEW TBS Title, appearing on WrestleDream, rated 6.65. Julia Hart was challenging for gold for the very first time. Kris Statlander was chasing gold for the 10th time. Julia Hart pushed Statlander to her limit in her pay-per-view singles debut, but multiple tombstone piledrivers were enough for the champion to retain the TBS Title.

That Wednesday in 2025, Darby Allin chalked up their 150th recorded AEW match ? proof of just how much mileage they've put in, facing Darby Allin vs. Kris Statlander vs. Marina Shafir vs. Wheeler Yuta in a Tornado Tag match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.45 ? a strong outing.
2023 brought us this moment: it was the first-ever encounter between Bryan Danielson and Zack Sabre Jr. on WrestleDream, rated 9.53 ? an instant classic.
